feature_generation.missing_history_policy: use_zero_or_neutral only where explicitly defined by feature; never backfill from future matches

features.name: team_a_recent_win_rate
features.definition: expanding pre-match ODI win rate for Team A

features.name: team_b_recent_win_rate
features.definition: expanding pre-match ODI win rate for Team B

features.name: team_a_batting_runs_per_ball
features.definition: expanding ODI runs per legal ball scored by Team A

features.name: team_b_batting_runs_per_ball
features.definition: expanding ODI runs per legal ball scored by Team B

features.name: team_a_wickets_per_ball
features.definition: expanding ODI wickets taken by Team A per legal ball bowled

features.name: team_b_wickets_per_ball
features.definition: expanding ODI wickets taken by Team B per legal ball bowled

features.name: team_a_runs_conceded_per_ball
features.definition: expanding ODI runs conceded by Team A per legal ball bowled

features.name: team_b_runs_conceded_per_ball
features.definition: expanding ODI runs conceded by Team B per legal ball bowled

features.name: team_a_chase_win_rate
features.definition: pre-match win rate when Team A has previously chased a target

features.name: team_b_chase_win_rate
features.definition: pre-match win rate when Team B has previously chased a target

features.name: team_a_defend_win_rate
features.definition: pre-match win rate when Team A has previously defended a target

features.name: team_b_defend_win_rate
features.definition: pre-match win rate when Team B has previously defended a target

features.name: team_a_minus_team_b_strength
features.definition: signed aggregate ODI strength differential derived only from the preceding 12 team-state features

promotion_rule: O0 is a reference baseline only; no promotion decision is made until the untouched chronological test and subsequent robustness process are complete
important_note: This contract deliberately defines an ODI-specific baseline. It does not reuse the T20 v0/W0 contract merely because the estimator family is shared. The exact split is not frozen until generated from the locked ODI population.
